base_member_text: [L336-L345] (MED/division by zero) Progress reporting divides by par%tstop in several expressions without guarding a zero stop time.
audit_member_text: [L336-L345] (MED/arithmetic) Progress and completion-time calculations divide by par%tstop without guarding a zero stop time.

base_member_text: [L233-L236] (MED/unchecked mnemonic lookup) The allocation check passes chartoindex directly to indextos without handling an unknown configured mnemonic.
audit_member_text: [L232-L294] (MED/input-validation) Output-variable validation passes chartoindex results directly to indextos and has no default rejection for unknown types or ranks outside 0 through 4, allowing malformed selections to bypass the association checks.

base_member_text: [L199-L213] (MED/nonfunctional error output) output_error claims that it creates an extra diagnostic timestep, but the output call is commented out and the routine only logs the claim before halting.
audit_member_text: [L199-L214] (MED/api-behavior) output_error claims an extra output timestep is created, but the output call is commented out and the routine immediately halts without using any of its state arguments.

base_member_text: [L297-L303] (LOW/MPI validation scope) The output-variable error flag is broadcast only among non-output-master ranks, so the output master does not receive the validation result before its own initialization path.
audit_member_text: [L297-L303] (MED/mpi/error-propagation) Allocation errors are broadcast and halted only within the compute communicator, while the separate I/O rank retains outputError zero, so the I/O process is not explicitly brought into this failure path.

base_member_text: [L61-L65; ncoutput state initialized only at L56-L60,L71-L79] (HIGH/uninitialized output counter) Pure NetCDF initialization does not call fortoutput_init, which is the only initializer for the saved drifter record counter used by ncoutput, so NetCDF drifter output can start from an undefined record index.

[L232-L295] (MED/incomplete output validation) check_outputvariables_allocated validates only global variables, leaving configured point and mean variables to reach later output paths without equivalent association checks.

audit_member_text: [L54-L80] (MED/configuration-validation) Output-format selection has no default case, so an unexpected format value silently skips all format-specific initialization.
[L125-L128] (LOW/logging-accuracy) The hotstart message is emitted whenever outputh is set and hotstart writing is enabled, before this module has evidence that creation actually succeeded.

[L310-L368] (LOW/state-lifecycle) log_progress keeps firsttime and timing accumulators in saved procedure state with no reset, so a second model run in the same process inherits the prior run's wall-clock baseline.
